🐣 Start from zero · Step 2 of 5 · 4 min

Everything is numbers

How letters, pictures and sounds live inside a computer.

🔢 Inside a computer there are only numbers

A computer cannot see, hear or read. Inside, it works only with numbers.

So everything it works with has to become numbers first: letters, pictures, sounds, videos.

🔤 Letters become numbers

Give every letter a number. Then any word is a list of numbers.

A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, D = 4, E = 5 …
CAB → 3, 1, 2

Real computers use a much longer table of the same kind. It has a number for every letter of every language, and even for every emoji.

Task. The code is A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, and so on down the alphabet. Which number does the letter E get?

Show the solution

A, B, C, D, E: the fifth letter gets the number 5.

Task. With the code A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, D = 4, how does the computer keep the word BAD?

Show the answer

Right answer: 2, 1, 4

B is 2, A is 1, D is 4. The order of the numbers is the order of the letters.

🖼️ Pictures become numbers

Look very closely at a screen and you will see tiny squares: pixels. Each pixel is one number that says how bright it is: 0 is black, 255 is white, and the numbers in between are greys.

This tiny picture is 3 pixels wide and 3 pixels tall, so for the computer it is just 9 numbers.

Task. A black-and-white picture is 10 pixels wide and 10 pixels tall. How many numbers does the computer need to keep it?

Show the solution

10 × 10 = 100 pixels, one number each. A phone photo has millions of pixels, and a colour pixel needs three numbers: how much red, green and blue.

Task. In a black-and-white picture, a pixel has the number 0. What colour is it?

Show the answer

Right answer: Black

0 means no light at all: black. 255 is the brightest: white.

🎵 Sounds become numbers too

A sound is the air shaking. A microphone measures that shaking thousands of times every second and writes each measurement down as a number.

So a song is a very long list of numbers. And a video is many pictures in a row, plus the sound.

Task. What does the computer turn each one into?

Show the solution

Different things, the same trick: measure it and write the numbers down.

Think first. Why does this matter for AI?

Show the answer

Because one and the same method can then work with texts, pictures and sounds: for the computer they are all lists of numbers.

An AI model takes numbers in, calculates, and gives numbers out. A photo of a cat goes in as numbers, and what comes out is a number too: for example 0.97, which means “97% sure this is a cat”.

Task. Why can the same AI method work with text, pictures and sound?

Show the answer

Right answer: Because inside the computer all of them are numbers

Letters, pixels and sound measurements all become numbers. A model takes numbers in and gives numbers out.

Remember

  • Inside a computer everything is numbers.
  • Letters: a number for each letter. Pictures: a number for each pixel (0 is black, 255 is white). Sounds: thousands of measurements a second.
  • An AI model takes numbers in and gives numbers out.
